zh.text: 多伦多大学是位于加拿大安大略省多伦多的公立研究型大学。该校根据1827年的皇家宪章建立，最初名为国王学院，1849年脱离圣公会后改为现名。大学实行学院联邦制，由11个学院组成，各学院在政务和财政上具有自治权。其主校区圣乔治校区位于多伦多市中心，毗邻安大略省政府及议会大厦。此外，大学还设有密西沙加校区和士嘉堡校区，共同构成其教学与研究网络。

en.text: The University of Toronto is a public research university located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It was founded by royal charter in 1827 as King's College and assumed its current name in 1849 after becoming a secular institution. The university operates as a collegiate system comprising 11 colleges, each with substantial autonomy in financial and institutional affairs. Its main St. George campus is situated in downtown Toronto, adjacent to Queen's Park and the provincial legislature. The institution also includes the Mississauga and Scarborough campuses, which were established in the 1960s to support undergraduate education.
